verdict.rationale: Dover's own pricing copy says the Premium tier adds offer management with e-signing, so offers with built-in e-signature are a first-party, paid-tier capability. That is the only mention: templated offer letters, dynamic merge fields and approval routing are not documented, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: templated offer letters with dynamic fields, offer approval routing, detailed offer-management docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of e-signing.

support.subject: As a recruiter, offers go out from the ATS — templated offer letters with dynamic fields, approval routing, and built-in e-signature

citations.quote: Premium is $199/month and adds AI applicant scoring, the AI notetaker, offer management with e-signing, bulk actions, and more.
